mapper.select:
SELECT p.id, p.project_name, p.status, p.start_time, p.estimated_end_date, p.actual_end_date, p.remark, p.create_time, p.update_time, GROUP_CONCAT(u.real_name SEPARATOR ', ') as managerNames, GROUP_CONCAT(u.id SEPARATOR ',') as managerIdsStr FROM sys_project p LEFT JOIN sys_project_manager pm ON p.id = pm.project_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON pm.user_id = u.id AND u.is_deleted = 0 WHERE p.is_deleted = 0
AND p.project_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{projectName}, '%')
GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY p.create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_project (project_name, status, start_time, estimated_end_date, actual_end_date, remark) VALUES (#{projectName}, #{status}, #{startTime}, #{estimatedEndDate}, #{actualEndDate}, #{remark})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_project SET is_deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
